title: He Jumped From a Jet With $200,000 and Vanished
description:
On the night before Thanksgiving 1971, a man hijacked a passenger jet, collected $200,000 and jumped out over the forests of Washington. He was never seen again.
So who was "D.B. Cooper," and what really happened after he jumped? The evidence points to an answer most people never hear.

hook: On the night before Thanksgiving, nineteen seventy-one, a man jumped out of a passenger jet into a freezing rainstorm, with two hundred thousand dollars strapped to his body. He was never seen again. No body. No parachute. No name. The FBI chased him for forty-five years, looked at more than eight hundred suspects, and still could not say who he was. So who was the man the world calls D.B. Cooper, and what really happened after he jumped? Stay to the end, because the evidence points to an answer most people never hear.
